description: Overview Think you can code under pressure? 5 problems. 90 minutes. 1000 marks. TechArena 2026 is a competitive coding challenge where participants solve 5 progressively challenging programming problems covering programming fundamentals, problem-solving, algorithms, and data structures. Compete individually • Solve challenging problems • Prove your coding skills Official Participant WhatsApp Group Join the TechArena 2026 Official Participant Group for important announcements, assessment updates, reminders, and event instructions. Join the WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/BJBcVe7T6w3IrSGYcxpQIk Participants are encouraged to join the group to stay updated. Top 10 Exclusive Benefit The Top 10 performers will receive a free .xyz domain for the first year, worth $15 , along with the recognition and certificates mentioned in the Rewards & Prizes section. Format Online coding challenge 5 programming problems Progressive difficulty: Easy → Hard Total: 1000 marks Duration: 90 minutes Participation: Individual Languages: Multiple programming languages supported Skills Assessed Programming • Problem Solving • Algorithms • Data Structures • Logical Thinking • Competitive Coding Rules Participants must complete the assessment within the allotted 90-minute duration once started. Each problem carries different marks based on its difficulty. Participants may attempt the problems in any order. Solutions must pass the provided test cases to receive marks. Participants are responsible for maintaining a stable internet connection during the assessment. Any form of unfair means or plagiarism may result in disqualification. The final score will be determined by the marks obtained in the assessment. Eligibility Open to students, developers, and coding enthusiasts interested in testing their programming and problem-solving skills. Participation Register through Unstop and attempt the TechArena 2026 Coding Assessment during the scheduled contest window. Organized By Learnix Labs ×

raw.details:
Overview

Think you can code under pressure?

5 problems. 90 minutes. 1000 marks.

TechArena 2026 is a competitive coding challenge where participants solve 5 progressively challenging programming problems covering programming fundamentals, problem-solving, algorithms, and data structures.

Compete individually • Solve challenging problems • Prove your coding skills

Official Participant WhatsApp Group

Join the TechArena 2026 Official Participant Group for important announcements, assessment updates, reminders, and event instructions.

Join the WhatsApp Group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/BJBcVe7T6w3IrSGYcxpQIk

Participants are encouraged to join the group to stay updated.

Top 10 Exclusive Benefit

The Top 10 performers will receive a free .xyz domain for the first year, worth $15, along with the recognition and certificates mentioned in the Rewards & Prizes section.

Format

  • Online coding challenge
  • 5 programming problems
  • Progressive difficulty: Easy → Hard
  • Total: 1000 marks
  • Duration: 90 minutes
  • Participation: Individual
  • Languages: Multiple programming languages supported

Skills Assessed

Programming • Problem Solving • Algorithms • Data Structures • Logical Thinking • Competitive Coding

Rules

  • Participants must complete the assessment within the allotted 90-minute duration once started.
  • Each problem carries different marks based on its difficulty.
  • Participants may attempt the problems in any order.
  • Solutions must pass the provided test cases to receive marks.
  • Participants are responsible for maintaining a stable internet connection during the assessment.
  • Any form of unfair means or plagiarism may result in disqualification.
  • The final score will be determined by the marks obtained in the assessment.

Eligibility

Open to students, developers, and coding enthusiasts interested in testing their programming and problem-solving skills.

Participation

Register through Unstop and attempt the TechArena 2026 Coding Assessment during the scheduled contest window.

Organized By

Learnix Labs × Zevik
